name: Gaslamp Cases 8: Quest for the Relic
summary: Play another episode of the famous match3 serial. A series of disasters strike India, unleashing great devastation. Parvati, a guide in the city of Varanasi, invites Morgan Johnson, along with his trusty companions Jack Brown and the mystic Tenzin, to uncover the mysteries behind these cataclysms.
